status: experimental v0.5 candidate; exploratory targets passed in this synthetic holdout; family regressions retained

protocol.supplements: max of each variant and v0.4, recalibrated on normal calibration windows
protocol.tail_policy: complete for every candidate and baseline
protocol.selection: More physical events, no loss of all events, precision >=0.5 and no increase in false alert minutes versus unchanged v0.4. Eligible candidates require confirmation across seeds and a fresh frozen holdout.
protocol.history: only previous contiguous minute, same run and asset; static fallback at warmup or bad previous quality
protocol.unavailable: any role with good_ratio<0.95, coverage<0.9 or missing: residual detector unavailable, score sentinel zero; baseline preserved in supplements

diagnostic.limit: Marginal extremes across all applicable roles are descriptive only. Multiple comparisons, regime/load changes and concurrent events can explain them. No same-seed normal counterfactual was generated; raw physical detectability is unresolved.

operating_point_protocol.stage: Second adaptive development stage, after representation screening; no test used
operating_point_protocol.selection: Original no-regression gate unchanged: more physical events, total detections >= baseline, precision >=0.5, false minutes <= baseline. Unresolvable cutoffs excluded.

frozen.selection_reason: Among eligible development points, static AE and static direct tie at 15 physical events; AE preserves more total events (71 versus 68), within baseline false-minute count.
frozen.policy: Same complete-tail windows for all; primary chosen before test, secondary seeds report variability; no reselection after test.
